genre_target: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
domain_context: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task2_DiscussBoth 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT21 (雅思大作文（Task 2 Discuss Both Views）8.5 分范文：工业自动化机器人普及的就业冲击与技能转型)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP34 -> BP36`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Thank you to all reviewers for your time and comments. We have carefully read your reviews and answered all your questions below. We hope you can raise your scores.
structural_constraints: S1 [致谢并提炼审稿人共同好评 Gratitude & Shared Praise]：We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our work's [Quote Reviewer 1 Praise] (R1), [Quote Reviewer 2 Praise] (R2), and [Quote Reviewer 3 Praise] (R3).

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.

genre_target: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
domain_context: 多模态灵巧操作与力触觉闭环反馈
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP46` 与全文样板 `FT21` 的后半部分（`BP37 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Our paper has some limitations. We did not test on very big datasets because we do not have enough GPUs. In the future, we will try more datasets and make the model better.
structural_constraints: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
